newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends touch lower in rangebound trading.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends touch lower in rangebound trading.

text.p: NYCE cotton settled barely lower as the market remained rangebound and treading water ahead of Friday's options expiry and next week's USDA crop report, traders said.
"People are just standing on the sidelines, waiting to see how the market handles both instances," said Jarral Neeper of Calcot Limited.
Neeper said people probably wanted the market to remain flat until the options expiry passed and the latest USDA figures were released.
December cotton went out 0.25 cent weaker at 72.27 cents per pound, traded 72.57 to 72.23 cents.
Volume was estimated at 5,000 lots compared to Monday's official 4,174 lots.
